---
title: "Class 13: The Jacobian Matrix"
subtitle: "The derivative of the spatial mapping"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
---

In [Class 12](12_Class.qmd) the spatial mapping told us where a parametric point goes:

$$
\underline{x}^e(\underline{\xi}) = \sum_{A=0}^{n_{en}-1} \underline{x}_A^e\,N_A(\underline{\xi}).
$$

It does not say how much a small piece of the parent domain is stretched or turned on the
way. We need that to change an integral over $\Omega^e$ into an integral over the parent
domain, and we need it to tell whether the element is usable at all. Both come from the
derivative of the map.

## The deformation gradient

Differentiating the sum gives the **deformation gradient**, also called the Jacobian
matrix. Symbolically,

$$
DF = \frac{\partial \underline{x}}{\partial \underline{\xi}}
   = \sum_{A=0}^{n_{en}-1} \underline{x}_A^e \left(\nabla_\xi N_A\right)^T .
$$

In index notation, with $i$ running over spatial directions and $j$ over parametric
directions,

$$
\left(DF\right)_{ij} = \frac{\partial x_i}{\partial \xi_j}
   = \sum_{A=0}^{n_{en}-1} x^e_{iA}\,\frac{\partial N_A}{\partial \xi_j}.
$$

In matrix form in 2D, with $\underline{\xi} = (\xi,\eta)$,

$$
DF =
\begin{bmatrix}
\dfrac{\partial x_1}{\partial \xi} & \dfrac{\partial x_1}{\partial \eta} \\[10pt]
\dfrac{\partial x_2}{\partial \xi} & \dfrac{\partial x_2}{\partial \eta}
\end{bmatrix}
=
\begin{bmatrix}
\displaystyle\sum_A x_A \dfrac{\partial N_A}{\partial \xi} &
\displaystyle\sum_A x_A \dfrac{\partial N_A}{\partial \eta} \\[14pt]
\displaystyle\sum_A y_A \dfrac{\partial N_A}{\partial \xi} &
\displaystyle\sum_A y_A \dfrac{\partial N_A}{\partial \eta}
\end{bmatrix}.
$$

Two things to notice. The nodal coordinates $\underline{x}_A^e$ are constants, so the only
thing being differentiated is the basis functions: $DF$ is built from
$\partial N_A/\partial \xi_j$, which is Homework 6 work. And $DF$ depends on
$\underline{\xi}$, so unless the element is a parallelogram it is a different matrix at
every point.

The determinant is the **Jacobian**,

$$
J = \det DF = \frac{\partial x_1}{\partial \xi}\frac{\partial x_2}{\partial \eta}
            - \frac{\partial x_1}{\partial \eta}\frac{\partial x_2}{\partial \xi},
\qquad
d\Omega = J\,d\xi\,d\eta,
$$

which is what lets every element integral be computed on the parent domain:

$$
\int_{\Omega^e} (\cdot)\,d\Omega = \int_{-1}^{1}\!\!\int_{-1}^{1} (\cdot)\;J(\xi,\eta)\,d\xi\,d\eta .
$$

## What the columns are

The first column of $DF$ is $\partial\underline{x}/\partial\xi$ and the second is
$\partial\underline{x}/\partial\eta$. These are tangent vectors: column 1 points along the
image of a line of constant $\eta$, column 2 along the image of a line of constant $\xi$.
Those are the curves already drawn on the Class 12 viewer.

Taken on their own, two arrows are not very informative. They become informative when you
see what they are the edges of. Take a small square of side $h$ in the parent domain. Its
image under the map is a slightly curved patch. The parallelogram spanned by $h$ times the
two columns of $DF$ is the flat approximation of that patch, and

$$
\text{area of the parallelogram} = |J|\,h^2 .
$$

As $h$ shrinks the curved patch and the parallelogram become the same shape. That is the
statement that $DF$ is the derivative. The sign of $J$ says whether the image keeps the
orientation of the original square or reverses it.

## The map and its derivative, interactively

Same element as Class 12: a quarter annulus, $1 \le r \le 2$, with nodes at the parametric
node locations.

* Drag the dot in the parent domain, or type $\xi$ and $\eta$. Both panels follow.
* Drag the gold control points in the physical panel, or edit the table.

There are three separate things drawn, and it is worth keeping them apart:

* The **mapped grid** is the faint blue and orange curves covering the whole element.
  These are the images of lines of constant $\eta$ and constant $\xi$, the same curves as
  in Class 12. They describe the map, not its derivative.
* The **gold square** of side $h$ sits in the parent domain around the current point, and
  its **image** is the filled patch in the physical panel. This is the actual image: every
  point of the square's boundary put through $\underline{x}^e(\underline{\xi})$, so its
  edges are curved.
* The **parallelogram** is the dashed outline in the physical panel, built from $h$ times
  the two columns of $DF$. It is the flat approximation to that patch.

The gold square and its image each carry two arrowheads showing which way the boundary is
traversed. On the gold square they always run counter-clockwise. If the arrowheads on the
image run the other way, the map has reversed orientation there, which is $J < 0$.

Shading is the value of $J$, blue where positive and red where negative. Where $J$ changes
sign the black $J = 0$ curve is drawn in both panels.

          <th>∂N<sub>A</sub>/∂ξ</th><th>∂N<sub>A</sub>/∂η</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody id="cp_rows"></tbody>
        <tfoot><tr><td colspan="3">Σ<sub>A</sub> x<sub>A</sub>·(…) , Σ<sub>A</sub> y<sub>A</sub>·(…)</td>
          <td id="sum_xi"></td><td id="sum_eta"></td></tr></tfoot>
      </table>
    </div>

      The last two columns are the ingredients of <i>DF</i>: each column of the matrix is
      the nodal coordinates weighted by one of them.

  </div>

    <span class="lbl">DF at (ξ, η)</span>

    <span class="lbl">areas of the small square (h = <span id="hshow"></span>)</span>

<script>
(function(){
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const VB = 440, PAD = 34;
const C = {xi:"#1f5fbf", eta:"#c2410c", node:"#e0a800", ink:"#18202b",
           grey:"#9aa3ae", pos:"#2f6db5", neg:"#b8322a", faint:"#dfe4ea"};

const nodes1d = p => Array.from({length:p+1}, (_,i) => -1 + 2*i/p);

function lag(p,a,t){
  const P = nodes1d(p); let v = 1;
  for (let j=0;j<=p;j++) if (j!==a) v *= (t-P[j])/(P[a]-P[j]);
  return v;
}
function dlag(p,a,t){
  const P = nodes1d(p); let tot = 0;
  for (let m=0;m<=p;m++){
    if (m===a) continue;
    let term = 1/(P[a]-P[m]);
    for (let j=0;j<=p;j++) if (j!==a && j!==m) term *= (t-P[j])/(P[a]-P[j]);
    tot += term;
  }
  return tot;
}

const st = {pxi:2, peta:2, xi:0.30, eta:-0.20, h:0.5, cp:[], view:null, drag:null};

function defaultCP(pxi,peta){
  const r0=1,r1=2,t0=0,t1=Math.PI/2,out=[];
  const Pa=nodes1d(pxi), Pb=nodes1d(peta);
  for (let b=0;b<=peta;b++){
    const th=t0+(t1-t0)*(Pb[b]+1)/2;
    for (let a=0;a<=pxi;a++){
      const r=r0+(r1-r0)*(Pa[a]+1)/2;
      out.push([r*Math.cos(th), r*Math.sin(th)]);
    }
  }
  return out;
}
const nen  = () => (st.pxi+1)*(st.peta+1);
const idxA = (a,b) => a + (st.pxi+1)*b;

function shape(xi,eta){                       // N, dN/dxi, dN/deta
  const n = nen(), N = new Array(n), Nx = new Array(n), Ne = new Array(n);
  for (let b=0;b<=st.peta;b++){
    const lb = lag(st.peta,b,eta), db = dlag(st.peta,b,eta);
    for (let a=0;a<=st.pxi;a++){
      const la = lag(st.pxi,a,xi), da = dlag(st.pxi,a,xi), A = idxA(a,b);
      N[A] = la*lb; Nx[A] = da*lb; Ne[A] = la*db;
    }
  }
  return {N,Nx,Ne};
}
function mapPt(xi,eta){
  const {N} = shape(xi,eta); let x=0,y=0;
  for (let A=0;A<N.length;A++){ x+=st.cp[A][0]*N[A]; y+=st.cp[A][1]*N[A]; }
  return [x,y];
}
function DF(xi,eta){
  const {Nx,Ne} = shape(xi,eta);
  let a=0,b=0,c=0,d=0;
  for (let A=0;A<Nx.length;A++){
    a += st.cp[A][0]*Nx[A]; b += st.cp[A][0]*Ne[A];
    c += st.cp[A][1]*Nx[A]; d += st.cp[A][1]*Ne[A];
  }
  return [a,b,c,d];                           // row-major [dx/dxi, dx/deta, dy/dxi, dy/deta]
}
const detOf = M => M[0]*M[3] - M[1]*M[2];
const Jat = (xi,eta) => detOf(DF(xi,eta));

/* ---------- transforms ---------- */
function makeTx(x0,x1,y0,y1){
  const iw = VB-2*PAD, s = Math.min(iw/Math.max(x1-x0,1e-9), iw/Math.max(y1-y0,1e-9));
  const cx=(x0+x1)/2, cy=(y0+y1)/2;
  return {s, px:x=>VB/2+(x-cx)*s, py:y=>VB/2-(y-cy)*s,
             dx:p=>cx+(p-VB/2)/s, dy:p=>cy-(p-VB/2)/s};
}
const parTx = () => makeTx(-1.2,1.2,-1.2,1.2);
function fitView(){
  let x0=1e9,x1=-1e9,y0=1e9,y1=-1e9;
  const bump=(x,y)=>{x0=Math.min(x0,x);x1=Math.max(x1,x);y0=Math.min(y0,y);y1=Math.max(y1,y);};
  for (const [x,y] of st.cp) bump(x,y);
  for (let i=0;i<=25;i++){ const t=-1+2*i/25;
    for (const q of [[t,-1],[t,1],[-1,t],[1,t]]){ const p=mapPt(q[0],q[1]); bump(p[0],p[1]); } }
  const m=0.14*Math.max(x1-x0,y1-y0,1e-6);
  st.view=[x0-m,x1+m,y0-m,y1+m];
}
const phyTx = () => makeTx(st.view[0],st.view[1],st.view[2],st.view[3]);

/* ---------- svg helpers ---------- */
const poly = (p,s) => `<polyline points="${p.map(q=>q[0].toFixed(2)+','+q[1].toFixed(2)).join(' ')}" fill="none" ${s}/>`;
const pgon = (p,s) => `<polygon points="${p.map(q=>q[0].toFixed(2)+','+q[1].toFixed(2)).join(' ')}" ${s}/>`;
const circ = (x,y,r,s) => `<circle cx="${x.toFixed(2)}" cy="${y.toFixed(2)}" r="${r}" ${s}/>`;
const line = (a,b,c,d,s) => `<line x1="${a.toFixed(2)}" y1="${b.toFixed(2)}" x2="${c.toFixed(2)}" y2="${d.toFixed(2)}" ${s}/>`;
const txt  = (x,y,t,s) => `<text x="${x.toFixed(2)}" y="${y.toFixed(2)}" ${s}>${t}</text>`;

function arrow(x1,y1,x2,y2,col,w){            // line plus head
  const dx=x2-x1, dy=y2-y1, L=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
  if (L < 1e-6) return "";
  const ux=dx/L, uy=dy/L, hl=Math.min(11, L*0.36), hw=hl*0.52;
  const bx=x2-ux*hl, by=y2-uy*hl;
  return line(x1,y1,bx,by,`stroke="${col}" stroke-width="${w}"`) +
         pgon([[x2,y2],[bx-uy*hw,by+ux*hw],[bx+uy*hw,by-ux*hw]], `fill="${col}"`);
}
// orientation arrowhead placed by arc length along a closed loop, fixed size
function loopHead(pts, frac, col){
  const seg = []; let L = 0;
  for (let i=1;i<pts.length;i++){
    const d = Math.hypot(pts[i][0]-pts[i-1][0], pts[i][1]-pts[i-1][1]);
    seg.push(d); L += d;
  }
  if (L < 1e-6) return "";
  let target = L*frac, acc = 0, k = 0;
  while (k < seg.length-1 && acc + seg[k] < target){ acc += seg[k]; k++; }
  const a = pts[k], b = pts[k+1];
  const d = seg[k] || 1, t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (target-acc)/d));
  const ux = (b[0]-a[0])/d, uy = (b[1]-a[1])/d;
  const cx = a[0] + (b[0]-a[0])*t, cy = a[1] + (b[1]-a[1])*t;
  const hl = 8.5, hw = 5.5;
  return pgon([[cx+ux*hl, cy+uy*hl],
               [cx-ux*hl-uy*hw, cy-uy*hl+ux*hw],
               [cx-ux*hl+uy*hw, cy-uy*hl-ux*hw]],
              `fill="${col}" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1.3"`);
}
const loopHeads = (pts,col) => loopHead(pts,0.125,col) + loopHead(pts,0.625,col);

/* ---------- J field + zero contour (marching squares on the parent grid) ---------- */
const NG = 22;
function buildField(){
  const g = [], Jv = [], XY = [];
  for (let i=0;i<=NG;i++) g.push(-1 + 2*i/NG);
  for (let i=0;i<=NG;i++){
    Jv.push([]); XY.push([]);
    for (let j=0;j<=NG;j++){
      Jv[i].push(Jat(g[i], g[j]));
      XY[i].push(mapPt(g[i], g[j]));
    }
  }
  let amax = 0;
  for (const row of Jv) for (const v of row) amax = Math.max(amax, Math.abs(v));
  return {g, Jv, XY, amax: amax || 1};
}
function jColor(v, amax){
  const t = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, v/amax));
  const c = t >= 0 ? [47,109,181] : [184,50,42];
  const a = 0.07 + 0.36*Math.abs(t);
  return `fill="rgb(${c[0]},${c[1]},${c[2]})" fill-opacity="${a.toFixed(3)}"`;
}
function zeroSegments(F){                     // segments in parent coords where J = 0
  const out = [], {g, Jv} = F;
  const ip = (x1,y1,v1,x2,y2,v2) => { const t = v1/(v1-v2); return [x1+t*(x2-x1), y1+t*(y2-y1)]; };
  for (let i=0;i<NG;i++) for (let j=0;j<NG;j++){
    const P = [[g[i],g[j],Jv[i][j]], [g[i+1],g[j],Jv[i+1][j]],
               [g[i+1],g[j+1],Jv[i+1][j+1]], [g[i],g[j+1],Jv[i][j+1]]];
    const cr = [];
    for (let k=0;k<4;k++){
      const A = P[k], B = P[(k+1)%4];
      if ((A[2] < 0) !== (B[2] < 0)) cr.push(ip(A[0],A[1],A[2],B[0],B[1],B[2]));
    }
    if (cr.length === 2) out.push([cr[0], cr[1]]);
    else if (cr.length === 4){ out.push([cr[0],cr[1]]); out.push([cr[2],cr[3]]); }
  }
  return out;
}

/* ---------- the small square ---------- */
function effH(){ return Math.max(0.02, Math.min(st.h, 2*(1-Math.abs(st.xi)), 2*(1-Math.abs(st.eta)))); }
function squareLoop(h, n){                    // parent-space boundary, counter-clockwise
  const s = h/2, pts = [];
  const cs = [[-s,-s],[s,-s],[s,s],[-s,s]];
  for (let k=0;k<4;k++){
    const A = cs[k], B = cs[(k+1)%4];
    for (let m=0;m<n;m++){
      const t = m/n;
      pts.push([st.xi + A[0] + t*(B[0]-A[0]), st.eta + A[1] + t*(B[1]-A[1])]);
    }
  }
  pts.push(pts[0].slice());
  return pts;
}
function shoelace(p){
  let a = 0;
  for (let i=0;i<p.length-1;i++) a += p[i][0]*p[i+1][1] - p[i+1][0]*p[i][1];
  return a/2;
}

/* ---------- drawing ---------- */
function drawParent(F){
  const T = parTx(), o = [], h = effH();

  if ($("t_field").checked){
    for (let i=0;i<NG;i++) for (let j=0;j<NG;j++){
      const q = [[F.g[i],F.g[j]],[F.g[i+1],F.g[j]],[F.g[i+1],F.g[j+1]],[F.g[i],F.g[j+1]]]
                .map(p => [T.px(p[0]), T.py(p[1])]);
      const v = (F.Jv[i][j]+F.Jv[i+1][j]+F.Jv[i+1][j+1]+F.Jv[i][j+1])/4;
      o.push(pgon(q, jColor(v, F.amax) + ' stroke="none"'));
    }
  }
  for (const v of nodes1d(st.pxi))  o.push(line(T.px(v),T.py(-1),T.px(v),T.py(1), `stroke="${C.faint}"`));
  for (const v of nodes1d(st.peta)) o.push(line(T.px(-1),T.py(v),T.px(1),T.py(v), `stroke="${C.faint}"`));
  o.push(pgon([[-1,-1],[1,-1],[1,1],[-1,1]].map(p=>[T.px(p[0]),T.py(p[1])]),
        `fill="none" stroke="${C.ink}" stroke-width="2"`));

  if ($("t_zero").checked)
    for (const s of zeroSegments(F))
      o.push(line(T.px(s[0][0]),T.py(s[0][1]),T.px(s[1][0]),T.py(s[1][1]),
             `stroke="${C.ink}" stroke-width="2.6"`));

  // the small square, drawn counter-clockwise
  const loop = squareLoop(h, 6).map(p => [T.px(p[0]), T.py(p[1])]);
  o.push(pgon(loop.slice(0,-1), `fill="${C.node}" fill-opacity="0.28" stroke="${C.node}" stroke-width="2"`));
  o.push(loopHeads(loop, C.ink));

  // unit parametric directions
  const L = 0.30*T.s;
  o.push(arrow(T.px(st.xi),T.py(st.eta),T.px(st.xi)+L,T.py(st.eta), C.xi, 2));
  o.push(arrow(T.px(st.xi),T.py(st.eta),T.px(st.xi),T.py(st.eta)-L, C.eta, 2));
  o.push(circ(T.px(st.xi),T.py(st.eta),5,`fill="#fff" stroke="${C.ink}" stroke-width="2.2"`));

  o.push(txt(T.px(0), T.py(-1)+20, "ξ", `text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="${C.xi}" font-style="italic"`));
  o.push(txt(T.px(-1)-15, T.py(0)+4, "η", `text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="${C.eta}" font-style="italic"`));
  $("svg_par").innerHTML = o.join("");
}

function drawPhysical(F){
  const T = phyTx(), o = [], h = effH();
  const S = Array.from({length:41},(_,i)=>-1+2*i/40);

  if ($("t_field").checked){
    for (let i=0;i<NG;i++) for (let j=0;j<NG;j++){
      const q = [F.XY[i][j], F.XY[i+1][j], F.XY[i+1][j+1], F.XY[i][j+1]]
                .map(p => [T.px(p[0]), T.py(p[1])]);
      const v = (F.Jv[i][j]+F.Jv[i+1][j]+F.Jv[i+1][j+1]+F.Jv[i][j+1])/4;
      o.push(pgon(q, jColor(v, F.amax) + ' stroke="none"'));
    }
  }
  if ($("t_grid").checked){
    for (let k=0;k<7;k++){
      const c = -1 + 2*k/6;
      o.push(poly(S.map(t=>{const p=mapPt(t,c);return [T.px(p[0]),T.py(p[1])];}),
             `stroke="${C.xi}" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-opacity="0.5"`));
      o.push(poly(S.map(t=>{const p=mapPt(c,t);return [T.px(p[0]),T.py(p[1])];}),
             `stroke="${C.eta}" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-opacity="0.5"`));
    }
  }
  for (const e of [[-1,1],[1,1],[-1,0],[1,0]]){
    const pts = S.map(t=>{const p = e[1] ? mapPt(t,e[0]) : mapPt(e[0],t); return [T.px(p[0]),T.py(p[1])];});
    o.push(poly(pts, `stroke="${C.ink}" stroke-width="2.2"`));
  }
  if ($("t_zero").checked)
    for (const s of zeroSegments(F)){
      const a = mapPt(s[0][0],s[0][1]), b = mapPt(s[1][0],s[1][1]);
      o.push(line(T.px(a[0]),T.py(a[1]),T.px(b[0]),T.py(b[1]),`stroke="${C.ink}" stroke-width="2.6"`));
    }

  const M = DF(st.xi, st.eta), J = detOf(M);
  const P = mapPt(st.xi, st.eta);
  const sgn = J > 1e-9 ? C.pos : (J < -1e-9 ? C.neg : "#8a6d1a");

  // image of the small square: every boundary point put through the map
  const img = squareLoop(h, 12).map(p => mapPt(p[0], p[1]));
  if ($("t_img").checked){
    const ip = img.map(p => [T.px(p[0]), T.py(p[1])]);
    o.push(pgon(ip, `fill="${sgn}" fill-opacity="0.26" stroke="${sgn}" stroke-width="1.6"`));
    o.push(loopHeads(ip, C.ink));
  }
  // parallelogram predicted by DF
  if ($("t_par").checked){
    const s = h/2;
    const cor = [[-s,-s],[s,-s],[s,s],[-s,s]].map(([u,v]) =>
      [T.px(P[0] + M[0]*u + M[1]*v), T.py(P[1] + M[2]*u + M[3]*v)]);
    o.push(pgon(cor, `fill="none" stroke="${C.ink}" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-dasharray="6 4"`));
  }
  // the two columns of DF
  o.push(arrow(T.px(P[0]),T.py(P[1]),T.px(P[0]+M[0]*h/2),T.py(P[1]+M[2]*h/2), C.xi, 2.6));
  o.push(arrow(T.px(P[0]),T.py(P[1]),T.px(P[0]+M[1]*h/2),T.py(P[1]+M[3]*h/2), C.eta, 2.6));

  for (let A=0;A<nen();A++){
    const hot = st.drag && st.drag.kind==='cp' && st.drag.A===A;
    o.push(circ(T.px(st.cp[A][0]),T.py(st.cp[A][1]), hot?8:6,
           `fill="${C.node}" stroke="${C.ink}" stroke-width="1.5"`));
    o.push(txt(T.px(st.cp[A][0])+9, T.py(st.cp[A][1])-8, A,
           `font-size="10.5" font-family="monospace" fill="${C.ink}"`));
  }
  o.push(circ(T.px(P[0]),T.py(P[1]),5,`fill="#fff" stroke="${C.ink}" stroke-width="2.2"`));
  $("svg_phy").innerHTML = o.join("");
}

/* ---------- numbers ---------- */
const f4 = v => (Math.abs(v) < 5e-5 ? 0 : v).toFixed(4);

function drawNumbers(){
  const M = DF(st.xi, st.eta), J = detOf(M), h = effH();
  $("mat").innerHTML =
    `<span>${f4(M[0])}</span><span>${f4(M[1])}</span>` +
    `<span>${f4(M[2])}</span><span>${f4(M[3])}</span>`;

  const cls = J > 1e-9 ? "jc-pos" : (J < -1e-9 ? "jc-neg" : "jc-zero");
  const word = J > 1e-9 ? "positive — orientation preserved"
             : (J < -1e-9 ? "negative — orientation reversed, the element is folded here"
                          : "zero — the map is singular here");
  $("detline").innerHTML =
    `(${f4(M[0])})(${f4(M[3])}) − (${f4(M[1])})(${f4(M[2])}) = ` +
    `<span class="${cls}">${f4(J)}</span><br><span class="${cls}">${word}</span>`;

  const img = squareLoop(h, 12).map(p => mapPt(p[0], p[1]));
  const trueA = shoelace(img), paraA = J*h*h;
  $("hshow").textContent = h.toFixed(3) + (h < st.h - 1e-9 ? " (reduced to fit)" : "");
  $("arealine").innerHTML =
    `parent square      h²      = ${f4(h*h)}<br>` +
    `DF parallelogram   J·h²    = ${f4(paraA)}<br>` +
    `image of the square (signed) = ${f4(trueA)}<br>` +
    `<span style="color:#6b7684">ratio image/parallelogram = ${f4(trueA/(paraA||1e-12))} → 1 as h → 0</span>`;
}

function drawTable(rebuild){
  const {Nx,Ne} = shape(st.xi, st.eta);
  const M = DF(st.xi, st.eta);
  if (rebuild){
    const rows = [];
    for (let A=0;A<nen();A++)
      rows.push(`<tr><td>${A}</td>` +
        `<td><input type="number" step="0.05" data-A="${A}" data-c="0" value="${st.cp[A][0].toFixed(4)}"></td>` +
        `<td><input type="number" step="0.05" data-A="${A}" data-c="1" value="${st.cp[A][1].toFixed(4)}"></td>` +
        `<td>${f4(Nx[A])}</td><td>${f4(Ne[A])}</td></tr>`);
    $("cp_rows").innerHTML = rows.join("");
    for (const inp of $("cp_rows").querySelectorAll("input"))
      inp.addEventListener("change", e => {
        const A = +e.target.getAttribute("data-A"), c = +e.target.getAttribute("data-c");
        const v = parseFloat(e.target.value);
        if (Number.isFinite(v)){ st.cp[A][c] = v; render(false); }
      });
  } else {
    const trs = $("cp_rows").querySelectorAll("tr");
    trs.forEach((tr,A) => {
      const td = tr.querySelectorAll("td");
      td[3].textContent = f4(Nx[A]); td[4].textContent = f4(Ne[A]);
    });
  }
  $("sum_xi").textContent  = `${f4(M[0])}, ${f4(M[2])}`;
  $("sum_eta").textContent = `${f4(M[1])}, ${f4(M[3])}`;
}

function render(rebuild = true){
  $("pxi_o").value = st.pxi; $("peta_o").value = st.peta; $("hh_o").value = st.h.toFixed(2);
  $("xi").value = st.xi; $("xi_n").value = st.xi.toFixed(3);
  $("eta").value = st.eta; $("eta_n").value = st.eta.toFixed(3);
  if (!st.view) fitView();
  const F = buildField();
  drawParent(F); drawPhysical(F); drawNumbers(); drawTable(rebuild);
}

/* ---------- interaction ---------- */
function svgPt(svg, ev){
  const r = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
  return [(ev.clientX-r.left)*(VB/r.width), (ev.clientY-r.top)*(VB/r.height)];
}
const clamp = v => Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, v));

$("svg_par").addEventListener("pointerdown", ev => {
  const T = parTx(), [px,py] = svgPt($("svg_par"), ev);
  st.xi = clamp(T.dx(px)); st.eta = clamp(T.dy(py)); st.drag = {kind:'pt'};
  $("svg_par").setPointerCapture(ev.pointerId); render(false);
});
$("svg_par").addEventListener("pointermove", ev => {
  if (!st.drag || st.drag.kind!=='pt') return;
  const T = parTx(), [px,py] = svgPt($("svg_par"), ev);
  st.xi = clamp(T.dx(px)); st.eta = clamp(T.dy(py)); render(false);
});
$("svg_phy").addEventListener("pointerdown", ev => {
  const T = phyTx(), [px,py] = svgPt($("svg_phy"), ev);
  let best=-1, bd=14;
  for (let A=0;A<nen();A++){
    const d = Math.hypot(px-T.px(st.cp[A][0]), py-T.py(st.cp[A][1]));
    if (d < bd){ bd = d; best = A; }
  }
  if (best < 0) return;
  st.drag = {kind:'cp', A:best};
  $("svg_phy").setPointerCapture(ev.pointerId); render(false);
});
$("svg_phy").addEventListener("pointermove", ev => {
  if (!st.drag || st.drag.kind!=='cp') return;
  const T = phyTx(), [px,py] = svgPt($("svg_phy"), ev);
  st.cp[st.drag.A] = [T.dx(px), T.dy(py)]; render(true);
});
for (const s of ["svg_par","svg_phy"]){
  $(s).addEventListener("pointerup", () => { st.drag = null; render(true); });
  $(s).addEventListener("pointercancel", () => { st.drag = null; });
}

function setDeg(){
  st.pxi = +$("pxi").value; st.peta = +$("peta").value;
  st.cp = defaultCP(st.pxi, st.peta); fitView(); render(true);
}
$("pxi").addEventListener("input", setDeg);
$("peta").addEventListener("input", setDeg);
$("xi").addEventListener("input",  e => { st.xi  = +e.target.value; render(false); });
$("eta").addEventListener("input", e => { st.eta = +e.target.value; render(false); });
$("hh").addEventListener("input",  e => { st.h   = +e.target.value; render(false); });
$("xi_n").addEventListener("change",  e => { const v=parseFloat(e.target.value); if(Number.isFinite(v)){st.xi=clamp(v);render(false);} });
$("eta_n").addEventListener("change", e => { const v=parseFloat(e.target.value); if(Number.isFinite(v)){st.eta=clamp(v);render(false);} });
for (const id of ["t_field","t_zero","t_par","t_img","t_grid"]) $(id).addEventListener("change", () => render(false));
$("b_reset").addEventListener("click", () => { st.cp = defaultCP(st.pxi,st.peta); fitView(); render(true); });
$("b_fit").addEventListener("click",   () => { fitView(); render(false); });

st.cp = defaultCP(st.pxi, st.peta);
fitView(); render(true);
})();
</script>
```

## Reading the output

The table holds the ingredients. Columns $\partial N_A/\partial\xi$ and
$\partial N_A/\partial\eta$ are the two components of $\nabla_\xi N_A$, and the footer row
is each of them weighted by the nodal coordinates, which is to say the two columns of
$DF$. Nothing in the matrix comes from anywhere else.

Under $J = \det DF$ the three areas are printed together:

* $h^2$, the area of the square in the parent domain;
* $J h^2$, the area of the parallelogram $DF$ predicts;
* the signed area of the image of that square. <!--, by the shoelace formula.-->

Shrink $h$ and the ratio of the last two goes to $1$. That limit is the definition of the
derivative, and it is the reason $d\Omega = J\,d\xi\,d\eta$ is allowed inside an integral.

## Things to try

1. Move the point around the default element. $J$ changes from place to place: the quarter
   annulus stretches more at the outer radius than the inner one. A single number does not
   describe the whole element.
2. Set $h = 1.2$ and compare the filled patch with the dashed parallelogram. They differ.
   Now drag $h$ down to $0.05$ and they coincide. $DF$ is a local statement.
3. Set $p_\xi = p_\eta = 1$. The four-node element is a bilinear map, and $J$ is not
   constant: the shading still varies. A bilinear element is only a pure stretch when it
   is a parallelogram.
4. Drag control point $A = 1$ toward the interior of the element, past its neighbours,
   until part of the shading turns red. The $J = 0$ curve appears, the image of the square
   flips over, and its arrowheads run opposite to the ones on the gold square. That is the
   2D version of $dx^e/d\xi < 0$ from Homework 7, case 4.
5. Put the point on the $J = 0$ curve. The parallelogram collapses to a line: the two
   columns of $DF$ have become parallel, so the map squashes a 2D neighbourhood onto a 1D
   one and $DF$ has no inverse. Derivatives with respect to $x$, which need $DF^{-1}$,
   are undefined there.
6. Swap two control points that are not neighbours, for instance give $A = 1$ the
   coordinates of $A = 3$ and vice versa. The element outline may still look reasonable
   while the shading is entirely red. The outline does not tell you whether an element is
   valid; the sign of $J$ does.

## Derivatives with respect to $x$

The weak form needs $\nabla_x N_A$, the gradient in physical coordinates. But $N_A$ is
defined on the parent domain, so the only derivatives we can take directly are
$\partial N_A/\partial \xi_j$. The chain rule connects them. Since
$N_A$ reaches $\underline{\xi}$ only through $\underline{x}$,

$$
\frac{\partial N_A}{\partial \xi_j}
 = \frac{\partial N_A}{\partial x_i}\,\frac{\partial x_i}{\partial \xi_j}
 = \frac{\partial x_i}{\partial \xi_j}\,\frac{\partial N_A}{\partial x_i},
$$

which in matrix form is $\nabla_\xi N_A = \left(DF\right)^T \nabla_x N_A$. Solving for the
part we want,

$$
\boxed{\;\nabla_x N_A = \left(DF\right)^{-T}\,\nabla_\xi N_A\;}
$$

In 2D the inverse is written out easily, since

$$
DF^{-1} = \frac{1}{J}
\begin{bmatrix}
\dfrac{\partial x_2}{\partial \eta} & -\dfrac{\partial x_1}{\partial \eta} \\[10pt]
-\dfrac{\partial x_2}{\partial \xi} & \dfrac{\partial x_1}{\partial \xi}
\end{bmatrix},
\qquad\text{so}\qquad
DF^{-T} = \frac{1}{J}
\begin{bmatrix}
\dfrac{\partial x_2}{\partial \eta} & -\dfrac{\partial x_2}{\partial \xi} \\[10pt]
-\dfrac{\partial x_1}{\partial \eta} & \dfrac{\partial x_1}{\partial \xi}
\end{bmatrix}.
$$

Note the $1/J$. Everything said above about $J$ changing sign now has a second
consequence: at $J = 0$ the spatial gradient does not exist, and near $J = 0$ it is large.
An element that is merely folded gives wrong areas; an element that is folded also gives
unusable derivatives, which is what actually enters the stiffness matrix.

The viewer below shows one basis function at a time. In each panel the thin curve is the
level set of $N_A$ through the current point, and the arrow is the gradient, which is
perpendicular to its own level set in its own domain. The two arrows generally point in
**different directions**: $DF^{-T}$ rotates and rescales, so a gradient that points one
way in the parent domain need not point that way in the element.

<script>
(function(){
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const VB = 440, PAD = 34;
const C = {xi:"#1f5fbf", eta:"#c2410c", node:"#e0a800", ink:"#18202b",
           grey:"#9aa3ae", lvl:"#3f8f5e", faint:"#dfe4ea"};

const nodes1d = p => Array.from({length:p+1},(_,i)=>-1+2*i/p);
function lag(p,a,t){const P=nodes1d(p);let v=1;for(let j=0;j<=p;j++)if(j!==a)v*=(t-P[j])/(P[a]-P[j]);return v;}
function dlag(p,a,t){const P=nodes1d(p);let s=0;
  for(let m=0;m<=p;m++){if(m===a)continue;let q=1/(P[a]-P[m]);
    for(let j=0;j<=p;j++)if(j!==a&&j!==m)q*=(t-P[j])/(P[a]-P[j]);s+=q;}return s;}

const G = {p:2, A:4, xi:0.30, eta:-0.20, cp:[], view:null, drag:null};

function defaultCP(p){
  const r0=1,r1=2,t0=0,t1=Math.PI/2,out=[],P=nodes1d(p);
  for(let b=0;b<=p;b++){const th=t0+(t1-t0)*(P[b]+1)/2;
    for(let a=0;a<=p;a++){const r=r0+(r1-r0)*(P[a]+1)/2;out.push([r*Math.cos(th),r*Math.sin(th)]);}}
  return out;
}
const nen = () => (G.p+1)*(G.p+1);
function NofA(A,xi,eta){const a=A%(G.p+1),b=Math.floor(A/(G.p+1));return lag(G.p,a,xi)*lag(G.p,b,eta);}
function gradParam(A,xi,eta){
  const a=A%(G.p+1), b=Math.floor(A/(G.p+1));
  return [dlag(G.p,a,xi)*lag(G.p,b,eta), lag(G.p,a,xi)*dlag(G.p,b,eta)];
}
function mapPt(xi,eta){let x=0,y=0;
  for(let A=0;A<nen();A++){const n=NofA(A,xi,eta);x+=G.cp[A][0]*n;y+=G.cp[A][1]*n;}return [x,y];}
function DFat(xi,eta){let a=0,b=0,c=0,d=0;
  for(let A=0;A<nen();A++){const g=gradParam(A,xi,eta);
    a+=G.cp[A][0]*g[0];b+=G.cp[A][0]*g[1];c+=G.cp[A][1]*g[0];d+=G.cp[A][1]*g[1];}
  return [a,b,c,d];}
const det4 = M => M[0]*M[3]-M[1]*M[2];
function invT(M){const J=det4(M);                // DF^{-T} = (1/J)[[d,-c],[-b,a]]
  return [M[3]/J, -M[2]/J, -M[1]/J, M[0]/J];}
const matvec = (M,v) => [M[0]*v[0]+M[1]*v[1], M[2]*v[0]+M[3]*v[1]];

function makeTx(x0,x1,y0,y1){
  const iw=VB-2*PAD, s=Math.min(iw/Math.max(x1-x0,1e-9), iw/Math.max(y1-y0,1e-9));
  const cx=(x0+x1)/2, cy=(y0+y1)/2;
  return {s,px:x=>VB/2+(x-cx)*s,py:y=>VB/2-(y-cy)*s,dx:p=>cx+(p-VB/2)/s,dy:p=>cy-(p-VB/2)/s};
}
const parTx = () => makeTx(-1.2,1.2,-1.2,1.2);
function fit(){let x0=1e9,x1=-1e9,y0=1e9,y1=-1e9;
  const B=(x,y)=>{x0=Math.min(x0,x);x1=Math.max(x1,x);y0=Math.min(y0,y);y1=Math.max(y1,y);};
  for(const [x,y] of G.cp) B(x,y);
  for(let i=0;i<=24;i++){const t=-1+2*i/24;
    for(const q of [[t,-1],[t,1],[-1,t],[1,t]]){const p=mapPt(q[0],q[1]);B(p[0],p[1]);}}
  const m=0.14*Math.max(x1-x0,y1-y0,1e-6);G.view=[x0-m,x1+m,y0-m,y1+m];}
const phyTx = () => makeTx(G.view[0],G.view[1],G.view[2],G.view[3]);

const poly=(p,s)=>`<polyline points="${p.map(q=>q[0].toFixed(2)+','+q[1].toFixed(2)).join(' ')}" fill="none" ${s}/>`;
const pgon=(p,s)=>`<polygon points="${p.map(q=>q[0].toFixed(2)+','+q[1].toFixed(2)).join(' ')}" ${s}/>`;
const circ=(x,y,r,s)=>`<circle cx="${x.toFixed(2)}" cy="${y.toFixed(2)}" r="${r}" ${s}/>`;
const line=(a,b,c,d,s)=>`<line x1="${a.toFixed(2)}" y1="${b.toFixed(2)}" x2="${c.toFixed(2)}" y2="${d.toFixed(2)}" ${s}/>`;
function arrow(x1,y1,x2,y2,col,w){
  const dx=x2-x1,dy=y2-y1,L=Math.hypot(dx,dy); if(L<1e-6) return "";
  const ux=dx/L,uy=dy/L,hl=Math.min(13,L*0.34),hw=hl*0.5,bx=x2-ux*hl,by=y2-uy*hl;
  return line(x1,y1,bx,by,`stroke="${col}" stroke-width="${w}"`)+
         pgon([[x2,y2],[bx-uy*hw,by+ux*hw],[bx+uy*hw,by-ux*hw]],`fill="${col}"`);
}

// level set of N_A through the current point, by marching squares in the parent domain
const NL = 40;
function levelSegs(){
  const lvl = NofA(G.A, G.xi, G.eta), g=[], V=[];
  for(let i=0;i<=NL;i++) g.push(-1+2*i/NL);
  for(let i=0;i<=NL;i++){V.push([]);for(let j=0;j<=NL;j++) V[i].push(NofA(G.A,g[i],g[j])-lvl);}
  const out=[], ip=(x1,y1,v1,x2,y2,v2)=>{const t=v1/(v1-v2);return [x1+t*(x2-x1),y1+t*(y2-y1)];};
  for(let i=0;i<NL;i++)for(let j=0;j<NL;j++){
    const P=[[g[i],g[j],V[i][j]],[g[i+1],g[j],V[i+1][j]],[g[i+1],g[j+1],V[i+1][j+1]],[g[i],g[j+1],V[i][j+1]]];
    const cr=[];
    for(let k=0;k<4;k++){const a=P[k],b=P[(k+1)%4];
      if((a[2]<0)!==(b[2]<0)) cr.push(ip(a[0],a[1],a[2],b[0],b[1],b[2]));}
    if(cr.length===2) out.push([cr[0],cr[1]]);
    else if(cr.length===4){out.push([cr[0],cr[1]]);out.push([cr[2],cr[3]]);}
  }
  return out;
}

function draw(){
  const Tp=parTx(), Tx=phyTx(), o=[], q=[];
  const gp=gradParam(G.A,G.xi,G.eta), M=DFat(G.xi,G.eta), J=det4(M);
  const MIT=invT(M), gx=matvec(MIT,gp), P=mapPt(G.xi,G.eta);
  const segs = $("g_t_lvl").checked ? levelSegs() : [];

  // ---- parent ----
  for(const v of nodes1d(G.p)){
    o.push(line(Tp.px(v),Tp.py(-1),Tp.px(v),Tp.py(1),`stroke="${C.faint}"`));
    o.push(line(Tp.px(-1),Tp.py(v),Tp.px(1),Tp.py(v),`stroke="${C.faint}"`));
  }
  o.push(pgon([[-1,-1],[1,-1],[1,1],[-1,1]].map(p=>[Tp.px(p[0]),Tp.py(p[1])]),
        `fill="none" stroke="${C.ink}" stroke-width="2"`));
  for(const s of segs) o.push(line(Tp.px(s[0][0]),Tp.py(s[0][1]),Tp.px(s[1][0]),Tp.py(s[1][1]),
        `stroke="${C.lvl}" stroke-width="2"`));
  for(let A=0;A<nen();A++){
    const a=A%(G.p+1),b=Math.floor(A/(G.p+1));
    o.push(circ(Tp.px(nodes1d(G.p)[a]),Tp.py(nodes1d(G.p)[b]), A===G.A?7:4,
      `fill="${A===G.A?C.node:C.grey}" stroke="${C.ink}" stroke-width="1"`));
  }
  const sp = 0.42*Tp.s/Math.max(1e-6,Math.hypot(gp[0],gp[1]));
  o.push(arrow(Tp.px(G.xi),Tp.py(G.eta),Tp.px(G.xi)+gp[0]*sp,Tp.py(G.eta)-gp[1]*sp,C.xi,2.8));
  o.push(circ(Tp.px(G.xi),Tp.py(G.eta),5,`fill="#fff" stroke="${C.ink}" stroke-width="2.2"`));
  $("g_par").innerHTML=o.join("");

  // ---- physical ----
  const S=Array.from({length:41},(_,i)=>-1+2*i/40);
  if($("g_t_grid").checked)
    for(let k=0;k<7;k++){const c=-1+2*k/6;
      q.push(poly(S.map(t=>{const p=mapPt(t,c);return [Tx.px(p[0]),Tx.py(p[1])];}),
             `stroke="${C.xi}" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-opacity="0.45"`));
      q.push(poly(S.map(t=>{const p=mapPt(c,t);return [Tx.px(p[0]),Tx.py(p[1])];}),
             `stroke="${C.eta}" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-opacity="0.45"`));}
  for(const e of [[-1,1],[1,1],[-1,0],[1,0]])
    q.push(poly(S.map(t=>{const p=e[1]?mapPt(t,e[0]):mapPt(e[0],t);return [Tx.px(p[0]),Tx.py(p[1])];}),
           `stroke="${C.ink}" stroke-width="2.2"`));
  for(const s of segs){const a=mapPt(s[0][0],s[0][1]),b=mapPt(s[1][0],s[1][1]);
    q.push(line(Tx.px(a[0]),Tx.py(a[1]),Tx.px(b[0]),Tx.py(b[1]),`stroke="${C.lvl}" stroke-width="2"`));}
  for(let A=0;A<nen();A++)
    q.push(circ(Tx.px(G.cp[A][0]),Tx.py(G.cp[A][1]), A===G.A?8:5.5,
      `fill="${A===G.A?C.node:"#cfd5dd"}" stroke="${C.ink}" stroke-width="1.4"`));
  const sx = 0.42*Tx.s/Math.max(1e-6,Math.hypot(gx[0],gx[1]));
  q.push(arrow(Tx.px(P[0]),Tx.py(P[1]),Tx.px(P[0])+gx[0]*sx,Tx.py(P[1])-gx[1]*sx,C.xi,2.8));
  q.push(circ(Tx.px(P[0]),Tx.py(P[1]),5,`fill="#fff" stroke="${C.ink}" stroke-width="2.2"`));
  $("g_phy").innerHTML=q.join("");

  // ---- numbers ----
  const f=v=>(Math.abs(v)<5e-5?0:v).toFixed(4);
  $("g_gp").textContent = `( ${f(gp[0])}, ${f(gp[1])} )`;
  $("g_mit").innerHTML = `<span>${f(MIT[0])}</span><span>${f(MIT[1])}</span>`+
                         `<span>${f(MIT[2])}</span><span>${f(MIT[3])}</span>`;
  $("g_gx").textContent = `( ${f(gx[0])}, ${f(gx[1])} )     magnitude ${f(Math.hypot(gx[0],gx[1]))}`;
  const n1=Math.hypot(gp[0],gp[1]), n2=Math.hypot(gx[0],gx[1]);
  let ang = NaN;
  if(n1>1e-9 && n2>1e-9){
    const c=(gp[0]*gx[0]+gp[1]*gx[1])/(n1*n2);
    ang = Math.acos(Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,c)))*180/Math.PI;
  }
  $("g_ang").innerHTML = `${Number.isFinite(ang)?ang.toFixed(1)+"°":"—"}` +
    `     J = ${f(J)}` + (Math.abs(J)<0.05 ? ` <span class="g-warn">— J near zero, the gradient is blowing up</span>` : "");
}

function svgPt(svg,ev){const r=svg.getBoundingClientRect();
  return [(ev.clientX-r.left)*(VB/r.width),(ev.clientY-r.top)*(VB/r.height)];}
const cl=v=>Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,v));
function sync(){$("g_A_o").value=G.A;$("g_p_o").value=G.p;
  $("g_xi").value=G.xi;$("g_xi_n").value=G.xi.toFixed(3);
  $("g_eta").value=G.eta;$("g_eta_n").value=G.eta.toFixed(3);}
function render(){sync();if(!G.view)fit();draw();}

$("g_par").addEventListener("pointerdown",ev=>{const T=parTx(),[a,b]=svgPt($("g_par"),ev);
  G.xi=cl(T.dx(a));G.eta=cl(T.dy(b));G.drag={k:'pt'};$("g_par").setPointerCapture(ev.pointerId);render();});
$("g_par").addEventListener("pointermove",ev=>{if(!G.drag||G.drag.k!=='pt')return;
  const T=parTx(),[a,b]=svgPt($("g_par"),ev);G.xi=cl(T.dx(a));G.eta=cl(T.dy(b));render();});
$("g_phy").addEventListener("pointerdown",ev=>{const T=phyTx(),[a,b]=svgPt($("g_phy"),ev);
  let best=-1,bd=14;
  for(let A=0;A<nen();A++){const d=Math.hypot(a-T.px(G.cp[A][0]),b-T.py(G.cp[A][1]));if(d<bd){bd=d;best=A;}}
  if(best<0)return; G.drag={k:'cp',A:best}; G.A=best; $("g_A").value=best;
  $("g_phy").setPointerCapture(ev.pointerId); render();});
$("g_phy").addEventListener("pointermove",ev=>{if(!G.drag||G.drag.k!=='cp')return;
  const T=phyTx(),[a,b]=svgPt($("g_phy"),ev);G.cp[G.drag.A]=[T.dx(a),T.dy(b)];render();});
for(const s of ["g_par","g_phy"]){
  $(s).addEventListener("pointerup",()=>{G.drag=null;});
  $(s).addEventListener("pointercancel",()=>{G.drag=null;});}

$("g_A").addEventListener("input",e=>{G.A=+e.target.value;render();});
$("g_p").addEventListener("input",e=>{G.p=+e.target.value;G.cp=defaultCP(G.p);
  $("g_A").max=nen()-1; if(G.A>nen()-1)G.A=nen()-1; fit();render();});
$("g_xi").addEventListener("input",e=>{G.xi=+e.target.value;render();});
$("g_eta").addEventListener("input",e=>{G.eta=+e.target.value;render();});
$("g_xi_n").addEventListener("change",e=>{const v=parseFloat(e.target.value);if(Number.isFinite(v)){G.xi=cl(v);render();}});
$("g_eta_n").addEventListener("change",e=>{const v=parseFloat(e.target.value);if(Number.isFinite(v)){G.eta=cl(v);render();}});
for(const id of ["g_t_lvl","g_t_grid"]) $(id).addEventListener("change",render);
$("g_reset").addEventListener("click",()=>{G.cp=defaultCP(G.p);fit();render();});

G.cp=defaultCP(G.p); $("g_A").max=nen()-1; fit(); render();
})();
</script>
```

Things to notice here:

1. Move the point around with the default element. The angle between the two gradients is
   rarely zero, and it changes from place to place. $DF^{-T}$ is a different matrix at
   every point.
2. Pick a corner basis function and put the point near the opposite corner. Both gradients
   are nearly zero: that basis function has almost no influence there.
3. Drag a control point until $J$ gets small. The magnitude of $\nabla_x N_A$ grows,
   because of the $1/J$. The parametric gradient does not change at all, since it knows
   nothing about the element's shape.
4. Set $p = 1$ and compare with $p = 2$. The parametric gradients are simpler, but the
   spatial ones are still position-dependent, because $DF^{-T}$ is.

## Next

$J$ is a polynomial in $\xi$ and $\eta$ whose degree depends on the element, and that
degree is what decides how many quadrature points are enough. With $J$ for the area
change and $DF^{-T}$ for the derivatives, every piece of the element stiffness matrix can
now be written as an integral over the parent domain and evaluated by quadrature.
